## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and the narrow architectural layer affected.

## Evidence

- [ ] Focused positive test
- [ ] Focused negative/regression test
- [ ] `bash scripts/ci.sh`
- [ ] Documentation/examples match behavior

List exact commands and results.

## Compatibility

State source, API, manifest, lockfile, diagnostic, artifact, and runtime-ABI
impact. Link the required RFC/migration notes, or explain why there is no impact.

## Security

State changed trust boundaries, untrusted inputs, capabilities, limits, secret
paths, failure behavior, and rollback. Write “none” only with a reason.

## Claim check

- [ ] No readiness, security, determinism, or completeness claim exceeds evidence
- [ ] No secret, credential, private data, or generated local configuration added
